1.-19. (Canceled)218
20. (Currently Amended) An analyte sensor system comprising:an implantable analyte sensor configured to be inserted into a host and continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
an adhesive pad coupled to the sensor mounting unit to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of the host;
a [[first]] heating element included in the adhesive pad and positioned to provide heat to the skin surface of the host when the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host; and
sensor electronics hardware, wherein the sensor electronics hardware is configured to perform operations comprising:
detecting, by the sensor electronics hardware, that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into the host by at least receiving a signal indicating a change in an electrical property of the implantable analyte sensor[[,]]; and
responsive to detecting receiving the signal indicating the change in the electrical property of the implantable analyte sensor into the host, triggeringproviding, by the sensor electronics hardware, power to be provided to the [[first]] heating element, thereby providing heat to the skin surface of the host upon detection that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into the host, wherein the providing of the power to the [[first]] heating element being while the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host.
21. (Currently Amended) An analyte sensor system comprising:an implantable analyte sensor configured to be inserted into a host and continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
an adhesive pad coupled to the sensor mounting unit to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of the host; [[and]]
a [[first]] heating element included in the adhesive pad and positioned to provide heat to the skin surface of the host when the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host, at least a portion of the [[first]] heating element being positioned outside a perimeter of the sensor mounting unit, and the [[first]] heating element comprising at least a [[first]] reactant that reacts in the presence of air to generate heat when the sensor mounting unit is removed from packaging and does not react when the sensor mounting unit is positioned within the packaging,
wherein the adhesive pad comprises a material that permits at least the reactant to have continued exposure to air after the adhesive pad adheres the sensor mounting unit to the skin surface of the host, thereby continuing to provide heat to the skin surface of the host after insertion of the implantable analyte sensor into the host.
22. (Currently Amended) The analyte sensor system of The analyte sensor system of wherein the [[first]] heating element includes an electrically resistive material.
23. (Currently Amended) The analyte sensor system of claim [[22]]20, wherein the sensor electronics hardware is configured to perform operations comprising:determining whether a break-in period is complete, wherein the break-in period begins immediately following detecting that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into the host and in response to receiving the signal indicating the change in the electrical property of the implantable analyte sensor, such that heat is provided to the skin surface of the host upon detecting that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into the host and at a beginning of the break-in period;
based at least on determining the break-in period is incomplete, continuing to provide power to the heating element, thereby providing heat to the skin surface of the host;
based at least on determining the break-in period is complete, after a first time period, ceasing to provide power to the [[first]] heating element.
24. (Currently Amended) An analyte sensor system comprising:an implantable analyte sensor configured to be inserted into a host and continuously monitor at least one analyte;
a sensor mounting unit, the implantable analyte sensor coupled to the sensor mounting unit;
an adhesive pad coupled to the sensor mounting unit to adhere the sensor mounting unit to a skin surface of the host;
a [[first]] heating element included in the adhesive pad and positioned to provide heat to the skin surface of the host when the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host; and
a sensor electronics unit installable to the sensor mounting unit, wherein the sensor electronics unit is configured to detect that the implantable analyte sensor has been inserted into the host by at least receiving a signal indicating a change in an electrical property of a contact of the implantable analyte sensor, and begin, in response to receiving the signal indicating the change in the electrical property of the contact of the implantable analyte sensor, providing power to the [[first]] heating element to heat the skin surface of the host after being installed to the sensor mounting unit, the providing of the power to the [[first]] heating element being while the implantable analyte sensor is inserted into the host.
25. (Previously Presented) The analyte sensor system of claim 20, wherein the adhesive pad comprises a permeability-enhancing substance.

in response to determining that a signal generated by the implantable analyte sensor is substantially linear while the heat is provided to the skin surface of the host, ceasing to provide power to the heating element.
